have just responded by telephone to a text message that I need to have a review of the strong drug this surgery had prescribed. The only appointment the receptionist could offer was 29th January, a month away. I explained that I was going abroad in mid-January for up to 6 months and she said that's the best they could offer. I asked if I could be notified if a  cancellation became available but she said cancellations do not occur for blood tests. She then hung up.
This receptionist was extremely unhelpful, abrupt and dismissive. She obviously wanted to get rid of me so she could get on with her New Year's Eve celebrations.
What was the point of messaging me in the first place, leaving me believing I might need to have urgent blood tests, if nothing could be done.
She said I could always go to Kings Mill hospital, ignoring the fact that I am 84 with mobility issues from a stroke and NO CAR.
